nirf_name: Shri Jagdish Prasad Jhabarmal Tibrewala University
description: Shri Jagdishprasad Jhabarmal Tibrewala University is a private university established by an Act of the Rajasthan state legislature in 2009 and recognized by UGC under section 22. Its 30-acre campus is at Vidyanagari, Chudela on the Jhunjhunu–Churu Road in Jhunjhunu district, Rajasthan, and offers multidisciplinary education including law and pharmacy.

agent_notes: Campus and district are confirmed on official pages as Vidyanagari, Chudela, Jhunjhunu-Churu Road, District Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan - 333010.

The current 2026-27 official prospectus and course-with-fee brochure establish the listed degree, diploma and other programmes. The public site also advertises generic Certificate Courses, Vocational Course and Training Program categories without named current catalogues, and the Doctor Of Philosophy (Ph.D.) card has no public current programme-detail page. The catalogue is therefore partial and requires manual review.
The official 2026-27 prospectus and fee brochure conflict on the durations of BNYS, B.Sc. Nursing (Ayurveda), and DAN&P (Ayush Nursing); those duration fields are left null.

The managed proxy returned the exact self-signed certificate-chain error on initial normal TLS requests. curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests after confirming the expected official/search hostnames.

Career-tree mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db with sqlite3 read-only queries. Node 20 has slug bpharm but the stored name Medical Updated; pharmacy mappings preserve that exact breadcrumb and are marked reviewed_with_career_tree_label_issue.
